maintenance: Independently maintained XSCC source; no build-time GPUI checkout or patch application.
source_archive_policy: Native GPUI source with maintained tests and examples; unused web, downloader, and tooling packages removed.
maintenance_changes: Use std::f32::consts::GOLDEN_RATIO in phi(); bit-identical to the original f32 literal.
Use nonblocking Windows surface acquisition and test contention without presenting an incomplete frame.
Expose core APIs through gpui_platform so the application uses one GPUI dependency.
Use Wayland-only Linux defaults and facade features.
Merge SharedString into gpui without changing its public re-export or serialization.
Remove Web backend, two network-image demos, unused GitHub downloader and performance harness; preserve the three style correctness tests.

Own packed BGRA pixel storage through RenderImage and reuse same-size image atlas allocations only on ordered-upload DirectX/WGPU backends; retain fresh-image fallback on Metal, resizing, device loss and upload failure.

Expose Hidden cursor style for application-painted pointers; Windows clears HCURSOR, macOS registers a transparent NSCursor and Wayland clears the pointer surface without using cursor-shape-v1. Optional X11 retains an arrow fallback.

Expose an opt-in reversible mobile session presentation request. Android uses its existing Java UI-thread bridge and AndroidX compat system-bar APIs without hiding IME; UIKit uses per-controller visibility/orientation policy and public scene geometry requests, preserving existing safe-area/keyboard geometry and restoring on exit/background. The application entry is SmokeActivity.setRemoteSessionPresentation(boolean), retained by an exact R8 member rule; AndroidImeBridge text-input code is unchanged.

Expose Window::painted_images only under cfg(test) or the test-support feature, cloning the last rendered frame's polychrome sprites for application scene regressions to inspect image layout, clipping and texture UV mapping; production renderer, layout and Img behavior are unchanged.
